title: Words to Move You
sub: Quotes on persistence, courage, and growth.

lines: It is not the critic who counts; the credit belongs to the man who is actually in the arena.
cards.meaning: Showing up matters more than judging from the sidelines.

lines: It does not matter how slowly you go as long as you do not stop.
A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.
Success is not final, failure is not fatal: it is the courage to continue that counts.
It always seems impossible until it's done.
cards.meaning: Hard things look easier in hindsight.

lines: You may encounter many defeats, but you must not be defeated.
We are what we repeatedly do. Excellence, then, is not an act but a habit.
Whether you think you can, or you think you can't — you're right.
You must do the thing you think you cannot do.
In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
I have not failed. I've just found 10,000 ways that won't work.
The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
The way to get started is to quit talking and begin doing.
What lies behind us and what lies before us are tiny matters compared to what lies within us.
You have power over your mind — not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
Luck is what happens when preparation meets opportunity.
cards.meaning: Prepare so you can seize chances.

lines: Winners never quit and quitters never win.
I've failed over and over and over again in my life. And that is why I succeed.
Don't count the days; make the days count.
Although the world is full of suffering, it is also full of the overcoming of it.
The only way to do great work is to love what you do.
You have brains in your head. You have feet in your shoes. You can steer yourself any direction you choose.
Turn your wounds into wisdom.
Success is to be measured not so much by the position one has reached as by the obstacles overcome.
What the mind of man can conceive and believe, it can achieve.
Well done is better than well said.
I am a slow walker, but I never walk back.
I fear not the man who has practiced 10,000 kicks once, but the man who has practiced one kick 10,000 times.
The mind is everything. What you think you become.
Be the change that you wish to see in the world.
There is nothing noble in being superior to your fellow man; true nobility is being superior to your former self.
Discipline is the bridge between goals and accomplishment.
You don't have to be great to start, but you have to start to be great.
Start where you are. Use what you have. Do what you can.
The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
He who has a why to live can bear almost any how.
Ever tried. Ever failed. No matter. Try again. Fail again. Fail better.
Nothing in this world can take the place of persistence.
How wonderful it is that nobody need wait a single moment before starting to improve the world.
Nature does not hurry, yet everything is accomplished.
